executive_summary: TechCorp's Information Security Policy partially aligns with the National Cryptographic Standards (NCS) framework, demonstrating a moderate level of compliance. The company has correctly implemented some cryptographic standards, such as using AES for symmetric encryption and RSA for asymmetric key exchange. However, several areas of non-compliance were identified, including the use of hardcoded and reused Initialization Vectors (IVs) for stream ciphers, utilization of RSA with a 2048-bit key length for the Moderate zone, and employment of SHA-2 for digital signatures and integrity in the Advanced zone. To achieve full compliance, TechCorp must address these violations and implement the recommended changes.
compliant_areas: Use of AES with a 128-bit key length for symmetric encryption in the Moderate zone (Section 2.1.2 of NCS)
Utilization of Serpent with a 256-bit key for block ciphers in the Advanced zone (Section 2.1.2 of NCS)
Employment of Elliptic Curve (ECC) based on NIST P-521 for key agreement in the Advanced zone (Section 2.2 of NCS)
violations: Hardcoding and reusing Initialization Vectors (IVs) for stream ciphers, which contradicts the requirement for a unique IV for each key (Section 2.1.1 of NCS)
Using RSA with a 2048-bit key length for the Moderate zone, which does not meet the minimum requirement of 3072 bits (Section 2.2 of NCS)
Utilizing SHA-2 (SHA2-384) for digital signatures, which is not accepted for the Advanced zone (Section 2.3 of NCS)
Employing SHA-2 (SHA2-512/256) for integrity in the Advanced zone, which is not accepted (Section 2.3 of NCS)
Using SHAKE128 with an output size (d value) of 128 bits, which does not meet the minimum requirement of 256 bits (Section 2.3 of NCS)
Using SOSEMANUK stream cipher with a 256-bit key for the Advanced zone, which is not accepted for ADVANCED (Section 2.1.1 of NCS)
recommendations: Implement a secure random number generator to generate unique Initialization Vectors (IVs) for each stream cipher key
Upgrade RSA key length to at least 3072 bits for the Moderate zone
Replace SHA-2 with SHA-3 (SHA3-256 or SHA3-384) for digital signatures and integrity in the Moderate zone
Replace SHA-2 with SHA-3 (SHA3-512) for digital signatures and integrity in the Advanced zone
Update SHAKE128 to use an output size (d value) of at least 256 bits
Replace SOSEMANUK stream cipher with an accepted algorithm, such as SNOW 2.0, for the Advanced zone
